description: Verify that 10 multicast FindService at 100 ms — DUT answers with unicast OfferService
approach:
[Objective]
Burst FindService: even 10 rapid multicast Finds must each get a unicast OfferService reply.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT (multicast): 10 FindServices spaced 100 ms apart.
2. Observation: DUT → Tester: ≥1 unicast OfferService.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied to multicast FindService burst — normal
